comment.narrative: Data source for indicator Number of migrants forcibly displaced people or individuals from host communities protected or assisted using the information from the UNRWA Health Departments statistic Number of persons individuals who used UNRWA health services as it provides the most accurate count of the actual number of people who used Agency health services in any given year. No double counting uncertainties.
The target represents a 2.04 per cent increase on the baseline which reflects the threeyear average annual increase in the total registered population.

UNRWA final reports submitted by UNRWA paper originals delivered on Friday 28062024 reg. on 01072024 Ares20244721327Final value of 2021996 refugee patients is based on the UNRWA 2023 Annual Health Report p. 75In coordination with UNRWAs Planning department in the lead of reporting on the performance of the Agency and indicator development the number of persons refugeesindividuals who use UNRWA health services was selected as an indicator since it represents the UNRWA programme which is universal to all refugees regardless of age gender etc. and also captures the largest number of beneficiaries accessing UNRWAs core services.Final value for 2023 was 2021996 refugees. Target was based on an annual projection however targets and baselines are for information purposes only as the number of refugees accessing UNRWA health services fluctuates from one year to the other according to the circumstances on the ground and as all registered refugees with UNRWA have the right to access UNRWAs universal primary health services.
